name: Last Frost Date Hardiness Zone MCP
description: USDA 2023 plant hardiness zone by ZIP code, median last spring and first fall frost dates from 30 seasons of Open-Meteo history, frost forecast and a vegetable planting calendar. Tools: hardiness_zone, frost_dates, frost_forecast, planting_calendar. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no account or API key.
author: theluckystrike
